title: Work Action Skipper
statement: For a Boolean list $x$, first apply the pair-skipping operation with predicate always true, then apply it to the resulting list with predicate $a\lor\neg b$ on each pair $(a,b)$. The result is the remaining list if both operations succeed, and no result otherwise.
caveat: The pair-skipping operation is not defined in the supplied context, so its precise behavior is unavailable.
